composition: Allocator e1 only; ContextText, BOLT and real/bulk training recipes excluded.

compiler_treatment.rust: Exactly -Ctarget-cpu=x86-64-v3 added to all normal/generate/use workspace vectors; Ohm rustc1.98.1/LLVM22.1.8, O3, ThinLTO, cgu1 unchanged.
compiler_treatment.expat: Exactly -march=x86-64-v3 added to normal/generate/use GCC13.3 O3/no-LTO vectors.
compiler_treatment.generic_controls: Earlier frozen generic builds on identical e1 source/compiler/config and original G288 schedule. No fresh generic rebuild in this study.
compiler_treatment.metadata: All Rust compiler metadata and other flags retained exactly; no broad normalization or sweep.
compiler_treatment.host: Actual Linux CPU0/3/5 capability metadata recorded; no instruction probe or general deployment resolver.

training.normal_scope: Normal artifacts have no PGO and only replay original G288 for correctness.
training.pgo_scope: Fresh v3 profiles from unchanged generated-only schedule, both namespace modes, minimal/full handlers and two repetitions.
training.callback_comparison: Exact same-engine normal/generate/use rows against generic controls. No claim that complete Oriole and Expat training callbacks match each other.
training.historical_manifest: Generic Expat retains older absolute-path manifest823f9adc with previously documented stale one-iteration/native-callback captions. Current portable manifest237f8558 uses corrected metadata; twelve XML byte hashes, schedule and all actual288 rows match.

posthoc.label: Requested after both campaigns completed; not one of the four original planned ratios.
posthoc.method: For each condition and original randomized cohort, recompute each worker median from its original nonwarmup raw samples, divide Oriole-v3 by Expat-generic within that same cohort, take the median of all seven paired ratios, then geometric mean across the fixed24real or4generated conditions. No multiplication of aggregate ratios.

first_outcomes.producer: All v3 Rust/Expat builds, generated replays and both native campaigns passed their first attempts. No target rerun.
first_outcomes.reviewers: Rust and native/post-hoc numerical readers passed first attempts. Expat/native preparation reader attempts01/02 stopped on reviewer manifest-type/history and abbreviated-caption mistakes; original scripts/errors retained, corrected attempt03 passed.
first_outcomes.package: Assembly and initial portable verification passed first attempts. A verifier-only hardening then pinned exact original auditor digests; follow-up replay passed. Original code/index/logs and amendment record retained; no archive payload changes.

limitations: No original absolute filesystem reads occur during replay; absolute paths in reports are logical archive keys.
Excluded compiler/library/archive bytes are not verified by this portable replay. Their hashes are recorded identities, separate from included source/log/profile/sample byte verification.
Build replay rederives raw vectors and compares archived training/profile/source bindings; it does not rebuild binaries or validate newly executed compiler behavior.
Native replay preserves all original planned and post-hoc arithmetic. It adds no parser runs, observations, full compatibility, Python or PBS validation.
The ISA study remains experimental/unselected and uses allocator e1 without ContextText composition.

verifier_amendment.scope: Portable-verifier hardening only; no producer data or archive payload change.

limitations: Saved-data replay checks archived bytes, raw compiler vectors/source/profile/training bindings and exactly reproduces original normal/PGO/post-hoc numerical audit bytes. It does not execute any parser/compiler/profiler or read original absolute paths.

Compiled libraries, tool binaries and source-capsule containers are excluded as payloads; hashes identify them, without portable binary revalidation. Included source capsules are expanded into exact source members. Reusable Cargo/CMake build trees and unrelated historical archives are absent.

The unchanged native driver times parser construction, handler registration, parsing/callbacks and destruction; input reading/loading/startup are excluded. The six inputs represent real XML fixtures, not complete application execution.

Native callback hash/element/text-byte agreement is narrower than full XML API compatibility. Its legacy driver has no fresh in-process dladdr record; exact library paths/hashes and separate training origins bind inputs.
Generic Expat PGO is faster than its v3 variant here. The post-hoc practical comparison is32.63% higher Oriole-v3 elapsed time, and must not be replaced by the more favorable matched-v3 comparison.
Single fixed runs retain all conditions and pairs; no confidence interval or universal speed/CPU compatibility claim.
